title: fix(plugin-sharing): a refused write on a federated object whose mapped owner column the driver did not serve is logged again
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiDTkG7yDwxUsQaHUFmCQQgM)_

Fixes #27662

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 外部对象用 `columnMap` 把远端列映到 `owner_id`、但驱动没把这列返回时，成员写入被拒的同时，服务器重新打出一行 warn（每个对象一次），点名「驱动没有返回映射的 owner 列」。
- **为什么改：** #27425 把这种映射算作已证 owner 后，#8418 的诊断不再触发，运维只看到一个 403，没有任何日志。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加日志，判决不变（三个写判决矩阵用例照旧）；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts` 的 `notePhantomAnchorWriteDeny`（新分支按「行里没有 `owner_id` 键」判定）；同文件新常量 `UNSERVED_OWNER_WRITE_DENY_NOTICE`；测试文件末尾的 `[#27662]` 块。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run src/federated-phantom-owner-scoping.test.ts`，预期 57 个用例全绿，其中 `[#27662]` 块 6 个。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `matchesOwnerScope` passes the pre-image row it already read to the #8418 diagnostic. No new query.
- `notePhantomAnchorWriteDeny` keeps its phantom-anchor branch byte-for-byte. A second branch fires when the object is federated, is not phantom-anchored, and the row came back with no `owner_id` key at all. It logs the new exported `UNSERVED_OWNER_WRITE_DENY_NOTICE` with the same payload (`object`, `ownerField`, `userId`) under the same once-per-object latch.
- The discrimination is the key, not the value. A driver that applies the map and serves a NULL owner is an ordinary owner-less row and stays silent. A missing record (no row) stays silent too.
- `hasPhantomOwnerAnchor` and `federated-phantom-anchors.ts` are not touched: the new branch reuses the already-exported `isFederatedObject` and reads no `columnMap` itself, so it adds no fourth reader to the set #27661 is consolidating.

## Tests

New `[#27662]` block in `federated-phantom-owner-scoping.test.ts`:

- a map-ignoring plugin driver denies on edit, delete and at `org` depth, and logs exactly one unserved-owner notice (never the phantom one);
- the wording names the driver and `external.columnMap`;
- a second object gets its own line, a second caller does not re-arm the first;
- a map-applying driver stays silent on an own row (allow), another owner (deny) and a served NULL owner (deny);
- a declared-owner control stays silent on allow and deny;
- a record that does not exist stays silent.

## Acceptance notes

- **Wider than "mapped" by design.** The new branch also fires for a federated object that DECLARES `owner_id` when its driver returns rows without that key (for example the SQL driver discarding a projection that names a column the remote table lacks). That is the same operator-facing fault, and the message says "maps (external.columnMap) or declares". The card's declared-owner control (owner present) is silent, as pinned.
- The method keeps its `notePhantomAnchorWriteDeny` name to keep the diff small; its doc comment now names both notices.

## Verification

Readings for head `41cbab7c` are in the os-dev-report on the card.
